title: Plugin Installation Failure: Missing PyCharm Plugin Directories
body:
The Intellij Claude Code plugin does not work. When I open Claude Code from the IDE (using the Claude Code button), a Claude Code terminal window opens and that works. But the plugin doesn't work - I get a "Cannot launch Claude Code" notification.

If I run the status command, I see:
"Error installing PyCharm plugin: Could not find plugin directories for pycharm
 Please restart your IDE or try installing from https://docs.anthropic.com/s/claude-code-jetbrains"

Environment:
IDE: IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1.3 (Ultimate Edition)
OS: Windows 11
Claude Code: 1.0.51
Claude Code IntelliJ Plugin: 0.1.11-beta
author: vladt

top_comments.author: hackyon-anthropic
top_comments.body: This should no longer happen since we have removed the option to auto-install by running `claude` within the built-in terminal, in favor of installing from the plugin marketplace: https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/27310-claude-code-beta-

top_comments.author: hkirste
top_comments.body: Same issue here, funny thing is if i run outside of the IDE's terminal (normal terminal) Claude Code connects correctly to the IDE.
